en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a shaded pathway running alongside a rocky cliff and tall trees. In the middle stands a small pavilion or shelter with people sitting beneath it, likely at a spa or spring area. The printed caption at the bottom identifies the scene as a view near the Johannisquelle in Bad Kösen on the Saale River. Publisher and date information are printed along the lower margin.
